Game Overview

Steve vs Alex Jailbreak is a arcade game built around guide Steve and Alex through a perilous pixelated prison escape in this thrilling adventure. Strategically navigate past creatures to uncover hidden keys and hoard enough gold to rev up your getaway car. With compelling challenges and immersive surroundings, can you plan the ultimate jailbreak?
